content: चूलिका [चुल् समुच्चये ण्वुल् पृषो˚ दीर्घः] .²1 The crest or comb of a cock. .²2 The root of an elephantʼs ear. <ls>Mātaṅga L. 6. 9</ls>. .²3 (In dramas) The hinting or indication of the occurrence of any event by characters behind the stage; अन्तर्जवनिकासंस्थैः सूचनार्थस्य चूलिका <ls>S. D. 310</ls>; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} in the beginning of the 4th Act of <ls>Mv.</ls> .²4 The crest (?) of a bow; प्रथमं चापमारोप्य चूलिकां बन्धयेत्ततः . स्थानकं तु ततः कृत्वा बाणोपरि करं न्यसेत् .. <ls>Dhanur. 118</ls>.
